$comment: Upstream ABI provenance pin (CC-50 round-4 MEDIUM-1). `check:abi-drift --strict` binds every must-verify ABI to a CLEAN, NAMED upstream revision: repos[].revision must match the sibling checkout's HEAD, that checkout must have no uncommitted changes, and each artifact must still hash-match the sources it records in its solc metadata. contracts[].abiSha256 pins the SDK's own vendored copy, so re-syncing an ABI without updating this file is a hard failure rather than a silent swap. Update it in the SAME commit that re-syncs an ABI.

SuperPaymaster.why: Registry 5.7.0 / BLSAggregator 4.6.0 — the CC-48 protocol candidate (versioned BLS domain separation, PoP validator binding, combined-path removal) the RepCredit evidence run encodes against.

airaccount-contract.why: AirAccount v0.29.0 surface used by the ERC-4337 lifecycle arms of the evidence run.

Registry.why: credit policy + reputation quorum entry point

BLSAggregator.why: domain/tag schema, slash + reputation quorum, guardian exit

DVTValidator.why: executeWithProof path. Vendored from SuperPaymaster's out/DVTValidator.sol/DVTValidator.json (the compiler's own output), NOT from its abis/DVTValidator.json: as of SP 03713feb/ebc05663 that hand-maintained copy is STALE — 16 functions vs 18 in out/, missing createProposal(address,uint8,string,bytes32) and queueSlashWithProof(address,uint8,uint256,bytes); it was last touched in 050f56b3 (2026-06-15). Reported upstream as CC-50 round-4 LOW-2; any downstream reading SP's abis/ gets the short interface.

services.$comment: Non-foundry upstreams that are pinned by REVIEWED revision rather than by ABI. Read by scripts/repcredit/experiment-auth.test.ts: in required/release mode (REPCREDIT_YAAA_HTTP_TEST=1) this pin is authoritative and REPCREDIT_YAAA_REV may not contradict it; a local run may still narrow to another commit while a cross-repo round is in flight, and says so. Keep it equal to the ref .github/workflows/ci.yml checks out.

YetAnotherAA-Validator.why: The reviewed DVT revision for the RepCredit experiment guard: versioned v2 HMAC preimage (scheme/method/requestTarget/timestamp/rawBody) plus the structured REPCREDIT_AUTH_* error-code table. Later DVT commits exist locally but have NOT been reviewed here — CC-50 round-5 LOW-1.
